inventions.name: The Log
inventions.text: They noticed trees float. A child rode a log down the river and is now chief.

inventions.name: Moon Plate
inventions.text: They carved the full moon into a rock. They use it as a very heavy plate. Dinner takes three people to lift.

inventions.name: Log Rollers
inventions.text: They move big rocks on rolling logs. The concept of 'rolling' spreads through the tribe like gossip.

inventions.name: The Stick
inventions.text: They burned a log until only a stick remained. They are very proud of the stick.

inventions.name: Spinning Top
inventions.text: They skewered a Moon Plate with a stick. It spins! Children love it. Elders ban it. It spins anyway.

inventions.name: The Ouroboros
inventions.text: Two snakes, one dream: a snake eating its own tail. The tribe is disgusted, but they can't stop drawing circles.

inventions.name: THE WHEEL
inventions.text: A spinning thing... that rolls. The tribe falls silent. Then someone builds a cart. Then someone argues about who invented it. You have done it. You have reinvented the wheel.

inventions.name: THE WHEEL (circle edition)
inventions.text: The sacred circle, spinning on a stick. They put it under a cart. It rolls! The snake priests take full credit.

inventions.name: The Hot Rock
inventions.text: They worship a rock the sun has warmed. Do not touch the Hot Rock. Kevin touched the Hot Rock.

inventions.name: Eclipse Prediction
inventions.text: They correctly predicted an eclipse. They are now unbearable about it.

inventions.name: Swimming
inventions.text: They watched a snake swim and tried it. Mostly drowning at first. Then swimming.

inventions.name: Soup
inventions.text: Soup. Nothing to do with the wheel. Delicious, though. Morale is up.

inventions.name: A Bigger Fire
inventions.text: They made a bigger fire. The forest has concerns.

inventions.name: Walking (Again)
inventions.text: They already knew how to walk. Now they do it harder.

inventions.name: Rock Kicking
inventions.text: Kicking rocks is now a sport. There is a league. There are fans.

inventions.name: Forest
inventions.text: They planted a forest. Several of them are now lost in it.

inventions.name: Tides
inventions.text: They discovered the tides. They blame you personally.

inventions.name: The Two-Moons Heresy
inventions.text: A faction now insists there are two moons. There is one. You know. You made it.

inventions.name: A Bigger Rock
inventions.text: They stacked a rock on a rock. Architecture!

inventions.name: Sunbathing
inventions.text: They lie in the sun for days. Productivity collapses. Tans are excellent.

inventions.name: Stone Skipping
inventions.text: Moon Plates skip beautifully on the river. Nobody has eaten off one since.

inventions.name: The Pizza Stone
inventions.text: They put a Moon Plate in the fire. It's a pizza stone. Pizza is still 5,000 years away. They wait.

inventions.name: The Frisbee
inventions.text: They threw a Moon Plate in a circle. It came back. They worship the Frisbee. The Frisbee priest is never wrong.

inventions.name: Recreational Boulder Rolling
inventions.text: They rolled a boulder downhill for fun. Two huts gone. Worth it, they say.

inventions.name: Whirlpool Dancing
inventions.text: They spin in the river until they fall over. It's called dancing now.

inventions.name: The Torch
inventions.text: Fire, but portable. Night is now 30% less scary.

inventions.name: The Hammer
inventions.text: A rock on a stick. Every problem now looks like a nail. There are no nails.

inventions.name: Snake on a Stick
inventions.text: A snake on a stick. Unclear purpose. Extremely popular.

inventions.name: The Raft
inventions.text: Two logs, tied together. The chief (the log child) approves.

inventions.name: The Seesaw
inventions.text: A log balanced on a rock. Playgrounds are invented before the wheel. Typical.

inventions.name: Waterwheel (too soon)
inventions.text: They invented the waterwheel. Before the wheel. Historians will be furious.

inventions.name: The Halo
inventions.text: Glowing circles over everyone's heads. Everyone is a saint now. Nobody is.

inventions.name: The Hula Hoop
inventions.text: A circle that goes around your hips. They are so close to the wheel. So close.

inventions.name: The Stone Donut
inventions.text: A rock with a hole in it. A very hard donut. Two teeth lost so far.

inventions.name: Bicycle (5,000 years early)
inventions.text: Two wheels, in a row. They ride to the next village to brag. It works.

inventions.name: The Hamster Wheel
inventions.text: A wheel you run inside of, going nowhere. They call it 'a job'.

inventions.name: The Flaming Wheel
inventions.text: They set a wheel on fire and rolled it downhill. It's a festival now. The fire brigade is also invented.

inventions.name: The Cheese Wheel
inventions.text: They looked at the wheel, then the moon, and made cheese wheel-shaped. The moon is jealous.

duds: They interpreted your dream as 'make a hat'. Everyone has a hat now.
They stared at the sky for three days and invented 'staring'.
The dream was misread as a dance. It's a terrible dance. They do it every night.
They argued about your dream until sunset and then went to bed angry.
Your dream gave the shaman a headache. He blames the snake.
They carved your dream into a wall. It's upside down.
Nothing happened, except a new word: 'huh'.
The tribe has decided your dream was 'just a dream'. Rude.
repeats: They already invented that. They invent it again, louder.
They do the thing again. Enthusiastically. You're very patient.
chatter: A child asks the shaman if gods have favorite shapes. The shaman says 'round'. Correct.
The elders are debating whether you're real. Two votes to one.
Someone is trying to drag a heavy rock on a sled. It's not going well.
The tribe is singing about you. The song rhymes 'god' with 'odd'.
A hunter returns with a story about a round fruit that rolled away. Nobody believes him.
The log child chief has declared a holiday. It's for logs.

oracle.text: The oracle whispers: 'What floats? Something tall... in something wet.'
The oracle whispers: 'The night's great round light... and something hard enough to carve.'
The oracle whispers: 'Put the floaty thing under your feet...'
The oracle whispers: 'Burn the floaty thing down to its skinny core.'
The oracle whispers: 'Skewer the round plate.'
The oracle whispers: 'A spinning thing... that rolls.'

ending: The tribe now has the wheel. In about 200 years they will forget it, and you'll have to do this again.
